scripts.deploy: npm run deploy -w annotated-api && npm run build -w annotated-web && npm run deploy -w annotated-app
scripts.db:migrate:local: npx wrangler d1 migrations apply annotated-db --local -c workers/api/wrangler.toml
scripts.db:migrate:remote: npx wrangler d1 migrations apply annotated-db --remote -c workers/api/wrangler.toml
scripts.test: npm run test -w annotated-api && npm run test -w annotated-web
